title: Orbital Remnants: Integrations
summary: Coordinate offworld routes with suits, maps, records, cargo handling, and recovery prep.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Stationfall shares pressure logic, Recovery helps after failed routes, HoloMap and Terminal track destinations, and Armory improves away-team readiness.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Stationfall pressure habits, Recovery planning, HoloMap destinations, Terminal records, and Armory readiness before taking longer away missions.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If route or cargo helpers are absent, shorten the trip, carry fewer objectives, and reserve enough suit margin to return manually.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
